dict.string: This also includes topics in the form of URLs such as `https://somesite.com`
This also includes various topics in the form `pass.<bundle_dns_name` for third party apps

User notification - The process that listens for UI alert for Apple and non-apple or third party apps. The topics are based on the installed applications of the user, and safari seems to create `web.<domain>` variants as well for HTML based notifications. Updates to Ubiquity containers have the pattern `com.apple.icloud-container.<bundle_dns_name>`
